conventions: bpp = Mbps*1e6/(W*H*fps) of the recorded file resolution; fixed = codecs whose bitrate does not scale with resolution/fps choice
source_note: Primary source: ARRI Formats & Data Rate Calculator v2.6.4 (https://tools.arri.com/fileadmin/adapps/afdc/index.html); numbers read from its embedded dataset https://tools.arri.com/fileadmin/adapps/afdc/js/data-embed.js (header: generated 2026-05-26). bpp = bytes_per_frame*8/(file W*H); Mbps@24 = bytes_per_frame*24*8/1e6 (FDRC formula, audio excluded). Same method as arri.json.

cameras.name: ARRI ALEXA LF
cameras.notes: Data from ARRI Formats & Data Rate Calculator (FDRC) v2.6.4 embedded dataset (generated 2026-05-26). FDRC stores a constant bytes/frame per mode, so bpp is fps-independent; bpp = bytes_per_frame*8/(file W*H), Mb/s = bytes_per_frame*fps*8/1e6 (audio excluded). maxfps = highest value FDRC lists across media. ALEXA LF (ALEV III A2X, 4448x3096 LF Open Gate). FDRC codec list for ALEXA LF = ARRIRAW + ProRes 422 HQ/4444/4444 XQ (dataset also holds ProRes 422 bytes for LF but the camera's codec list omits it, so excluded). ProRes is recorded on SxS PRO+ / Codex Capture Drive; ARRIRAW on Capture Drive only. ARRIRAW max 150 fps in LF 2.39:1, 90 fps in Open Gate/16:9 per FDRC. ProRes LF Open Gate 4444 XQ limited to 40 fps (byRes). ARRIRAW HDE is an FDRC multiplier estimate (0.6).

cameras.name: ARRI ALEXA SXT / SXT W
cameras.notes: Data from ARRI Formats & Data Rate Calculator (FDRC) v2.6.4 embedded dataset (generated 2026-05-26). FDRC stores a constant bytes/frame per mode, so bpp is fps-independent; bpp = bytes_per_frame*8/(file W*H), Mb/s = bytes_per_frame*fps*8/1e6 (audio excluded). maxfps = highest value FDRC lists across media. FDRC has a single 'ALEXA SXT' entry; ALEXA SXT W shares the SXT recording module/formats (SXT W adds built-in wireless video/control), so one entry covers both (SXT EV/Plus/Studio variants same formats). ProRes on SxS PRO+/CFast 2.0 (adapter)/Codex Capture Drive; ARRIRAW on Capture Drive. DATA QUIRK: FDRC's ProRes '16:9 2K (2048x1152)' entry carries exactly the same bytes/frame as '4:3 2.8K' (2072576 B/frame for ProRes 422 = 7.03 bpp, implausible vs ~2.66 bpp for every other SXT ProRes mode), so 2K is kept as a resolution but excluded from per-res rates - use the codec bpp. FDRC also subtracts 200000 bytes/frame for SXT ARRIRAW when computing record time (storage ~2-3% lower than the Mb/s figure given here). 4K UHD/4K Cine Anamorphic/Open Gate 4K Cine are ARRI in-camera upscales (ProRes only). ARRIRAW HDE is an FDRC multiplier estimate (0.6).

cameras.name: ARRI ALEXA 35 Live (Multicam System)
cameras.notes: Data from ARRI Formats & Data Rate Calculator (FDRC) v2.6.4 embedded dataset (generated 2026-05-26). FDRC stores a constant bytes/frame per mode, so bpp is fps-independent; bpp = bytes_per_frame*8/(file W*H), Mb/s = bytes_per_frame*fps*8/1e6 (audio excluded). maxfps = highest value FDRC lists across media. ALEXA 35 Live is an ALEXA 35 camera body (ALEV 4 S35) sold with multicam/live licenses (Live Production Server/fiber); its in-camera recording formats are IDENTICAL to ALEXA 35 - FDRC has no separate Live entry, so all numbers are FDRC's ALEXA 35 values (same as arri-alexa35). Licensing (ARRI Configuration Overview 2.0.2 / 2026.07): pre-installed base licenses = 0.75-60 fps, ProRes recording, basic 16:9 & 2:1 spherical formats, ARRICORE recording (Xtreme-ready 2026+ cameras); ARRIRAW, Open Gate/Anamorphic formats, frame rates above 60 fps and pre-record require extra licenses (ARRIRAW / Open Gate-Anamorphic / High Speed, or Cine Plus / Premium). Resolution maxfps shown are ALEXA 35 maxima with High Speed license. ARRICORE entry uses FDRC ALEXA 35 Xtreme bytes/frame (applies to Xtreme-ready 2026+ Live cameras only). ARRIRAW HDE is FDRC multiplier estimate (0.5).
